papers.title: Detection in Crowded Scenes: One Proposal, Multiple Predictions
papers.review: Abstract,introduction and rendered pages3/4 read. Each proposal predicts correlated instance set; EMD loss matches permutations; SetNMS avoids suppressing predictions from the same proposal. The paper explicitly says multiple-instance prediction has earlier precedents.
papers.overlap_and_limit: One proposal/multiple predictions and set matching are established; adding output branches is not novel. Candidate57 checks whether one frozen native position is a shared capacity bottleneck,not a reproduction of CrowdDet or a training efficacy result.

papers.title: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
papers.review: Abstract,introduction and rendered pages3/4 read. Set prediction requires permutation-invariant loss and global unique bipartite assignment; prior matching detectors and learned NMS/relations are reviewed.
papers.overlap_and_limit: Unique bipartite matching and simultaneous set capacity are not new. Candidate57 is an unweighted oracle inventory diagnostic,not Hungarian training loss,DETR replication or a deployable method.
